details: The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) for June 2026 showed a significant easing of inflation pressures, with the headline CPI registering 3.5% year-over-year, falling below consensus forecasts of 3.8%. This unexpected softness has reduced the likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in July, boosting overall risk appetite in financial markets. Bitcoin, in particular, responded sharply to the news, climbing from approximately $62,900 to above $65,000 within days, further supported by strong inflows into Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs).
title: US June CPI Eases, Reducing Fed Hike Fears & Sparking Crypto Rally

details: Digital asset markets are bracing for potential volatility this week, driven by two key events: the European Central Bank's (ECB) interest rate decision on Thursday, July 23, and a busy US regulatory agenda. While markets generally expect the ECB to hold rates steady, President Christine Lagarde's press conference will be closely watched for any dovish signals that could influence the euro-dollar pair and crypto funding flows. In the US, lawmakers are under pressure to advance a major crypto bill, and regulatory deadlines for stablecoin anti-money laundering (AML) standards (July 24) and public comments on Bitcoin spot-based perpetual futures (July 27) are converging, potentially redefining the regulatory landscape for digital assets.
title: ECB Rate Decision & US Regulatory Scrutiny to Drive Crypto Volatility This Week
